description: This file provides functions to extract and process text from various document types such as TXT, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX. It includes methods for extracting text content given a filename and raw bytes, supporting specific formats, and includes utilities for summarizing extracted text previews.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Main function to extract readable text from a file given its filename and content bytes, supporting formats such as .txt, .pdf, .docx, and .xlsx.

methods.name: str _extract_txt(content: bytes)
methods.description: Helper function to decode bytes as utf-8, ignoring errors.

methods.name: str _extract_pdf(content: bytes)
methods.description: Helper function to extract text from PDF content using pdfminer.six.

methods.name: str _extract_docx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Helper function to extract text from DOCX content using python-docx, including paragraphs and table cells.

methods.name: str summarize_text_preview(text: str, max_chars: int = 500)
methods.description: Produces a concise preview of the extracted text, limited by a maximum character count, for UI confirmation purposes.

ctags.name: extract_text_from_bytes
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes) -> Tuple[str, Optional[str]]:$/
